title: Over-Refusal Rate Tracker: A Benchmark Extension for Measuring False-Positive Safety Refusals

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses the fundamental measurement gap: safety benchmarks only measure one failure direction. Creating a 2D safety-utility metric enables Pareto-optimal alignment and prevents the degenerate solution of blanket refusal. Compelling impact on how the field measures safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Constructing benign prompt pairs requires creativity but no ML expertise. Running models on both suites and computing refusal rates is straightforward. Basic Python and API access suffice. Well within beginner capabilities.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: a paired benign-prompt suite and ORR metric. Constructing 50-100 benign prompts paired to existing harmful categories is the main work. Running evaluations and reporting 2D scores is mechanical. Fits 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
